release_notes:
## What's New

- Multi-church management: switch churches from anywhere, create and delete churches, with data correctly scoped to the church you're viewing.
- Admin profiles: edit, deactivate, or delete profiles; usernames are unique per church; deleting a profile that entered records is blocked to keep the record of who entered data.
- Currency and region: pick your currency from a searchable list, and set currency, language, and timezone at once by choosing your region when creating a church.
- Charts and dashboard now show all of your church's data, with a visible time-range selector to narrow the view.

## Bug Fixes

- Backup & Restore now works end to end: restoring a backup actually loads your data, and backups capture every church and admin.
- Imported data now appears immediately on the dashboard and in charts, without restarting the app.
- Fixed a hang when creating a profile, dropdown/app-bar layout glitches, and unclear field labels.
